text:
maria: heads up — auto-promotion blocked for release build 2026.03.21-rc3, deploybot returned extraction failures on two runners
ryan: I see `Bad archive header` in the runner logs, looks like wheel got truncated during cache restore
sam: paste of error: ```OSError: archive truncated
File "/usr/local/lib/python3.9/site-packages/pip/_internal/cli/base_command.py", line 200```
ops-bot: invalidation request received: `invalidate-cache --prefix builds/2026.03.21 --zone eu-west-1` queued
ryan: quick decision options — (A) pin canary to previous image 2026.03.20-rc9 to keep traffic steady, (B) reupload artifact + manual promote, (C) force bypass integrity in deploybot (unsafe)
maria: prefer pin then reupload/verify. We need a ticket and a changelog note if we pin
deploybot: promote failed: integrity-check failed for artifact://builds/2026.03.21/sha256:abc123 — action: hold
sam: ops — can you invalidate local runner caches for only this build so we confirm remote object is fine?
ops-bot: invalidation rolling; estimated 8m to finish across nodes
ryan: if invalidation fixes it, no reupload necessary. If not, reupload+verify pipeline will take ~12m
maria: decision: pin canary to 2026.03.20-rc9 now to avoid traffic impact, open ticket TICKET-5482 to reupload and manual promote rc3 after verification, and add temporary note in release channel and CHANGELOG
ryan: created TICKET-5482 and added security tag for provenance check after reupload
sam: snippet for eng ops if we need to force reupload: ```ci-trigger --job reupload-artifact --artifact builds/2026.03.21 --force
ci-trigger --job artifact-verify --artifact builds/2026.03.21```
ops-bot: invalidation completed; nodes report fresh downloads, running checksum verifies now
ryan: verifies green across all runners — no reupload required. Leaving manual promote to eng/qa signoff
maria: QA asked to run smoke: `./scripts/smoke.sh --build 452` — QA queued the job
maria: keeping thread open until promote or rollback executed; will post final decision here
